text: SitRep67 Tableau 6: 737 in isolation at end of day (286 confirmed / 451 suspected, a split that closes exactly against the census) at 86.7% global bed occupancy (737/850 beds); Ituri 78.4% (556/709), Nord-Kivu 128.4% (181/141) and still saturated; Haut-Uele and Tshopo report ND. The bed identity closes exactly at every level (700 J-1 + 180 admissions - 143 exits = 737; Ituri 536 + 118 - 98 = 556; Nord-Kivu 164 + 62 - 45 = 181). Exits over 24h (143 total): 27 deaths, 96 non-cases, 13 recoveries, 7 escapes, 0 HGR transfers. Ituri first-line personnel: 121 cumulative infections, 67 recovered, 18 hospitalized, 36 deaths (CFR 29.8%), unchanged from SitRep66 and internally consistent across all ten zone rows.

text: Ituri's bed CAPACITY fell 798 -> 709 (national 939 -> 850) while its census barely moved (553 -> 556), so the province's occupancy jump from 69.3% to 78.4% is almost entirely a denominator contraction, not a surge in admissions. Read the occupancy change as a reported-capacity revision. Recovered advanced +13 to 482 DRC cumulative (all in Ituri), against 27 deaths and 96 non-case exits over the same 24 hours; country-scope recovered 493 with the 11 Uganda anchor.

text: 50 new confirmed cases (Ituri 42, Nord-Kivu 8) and 32 new deaths (Ituri 27, Nord-Kivu 5) take the DRC cumulative cleanly to 2473 confirmed / 999 deaths (CFR 40.4%) with no harmonization this cycle. New confirmations fell 79 -> 50 while deaths fell only 37 -> 32, so the day's death-to-case ratio rose to 0.64 from 0.47. Deaths and confirmations of the same day are not the same cohort (deaths lag exposure and confirmation), so this is a reporting-ratio movement and NOT a case-fatality estimate; the cumulative CFR moved 39.9% -> 40.4%. Laboratory positives (42 + 8 = 50) equal the day's confirmations exactly.

text: NO new affected health zone was reported. text: The reported national contact-follow-up 'improvement' to 82.0% (9623/11739) from 81.1% is a COMPOSITION effect, not a performance gain. Haut-Uele, which reported 52.3% (162/310) at SitRep66, is ND this cycle and leaves the denominator; Tshopo returns at 100.0% (75/75). Holding Haut-Uele's last reported block in place would put the national figure at 81.2%. Within provinces the picture is flat to worse: Ituri 81.3% -> 81.8% and Nord-Kivu 83.8% -> 81.9%. The same caution applies to alert investigation, where the national rate rose to 84.1% while the EPICENTRE fell again, Ituri 75.6% -> 72.8% with 134 alerts uninvestigated; the national gain is carried by Nord-Kivu's large 91.7% block (737/804).

text: 16 of the day's 32 confirmed deaths were community deaths detected by post-mortem swab (Ituri 13 of 27, 48.1%), against 16 in-CTE deaths. A community-death share at half of all confirmed deaths is a surveillance-reach signal: those chains were not under care when the patient died. 322 suspect cases were validated on the day (220 living, 102 community deaths).
